notes.title: Stay Still 2- Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Players of Stay Still 2,

We're excited to present a significant update that will improve your gaming experience with exciting new features and fixes. We made an effort to improve the experience after hearing your opinions and being aware of the problems mentioned in the evaluations. We have greatly valued your feedback and have made great efforts to fix a number of problems and enhance gameplay. What's new is as follows:

Collision Fixes:

 Identified and addressed collisions in various areas to enhance gameplay experience.

Simplified Puzzles:

 Responding to your feedback, we've made puzzles in the pre-end area more straightforward. No more confusion or bugs; now, collecting three pieces of paper instantly provides you with the necessary code. Previously, rotating numbers to find the combination may have caused confusion.

Improved Progression:

 Fixed issues where players could get stuck after dying and reaching the next area. Now, in the paper printing zone, warehouse, and machine room upstairs, you won't encounter locked doors upon respawn.

AI Interaction Enhancement:

 Addressed an issue in the machine area where the ghost could open a door for you, but despawn if you walked on her back. Now, she will consistently open the machine door as intended.

Ghost Encounter Adjustments:

 The ghost can now hit you 2-3 times before causing death, depending on the specific area. This provides a fair chance to escape, but be cautious – hiding in a locker guarantees death if spotted. Use your legs wisely!

Intro Scene Removal:

 Eliminated the introductory scene showcasing the game, providing a more streamlined experience.

Objective Clarity:

 Strategically placed more objectives per scene for improved clarity, ensuring players understand what needs to be done in each level.

Code Clean-Up and Tweaks:

 Conducted code clean-up, along with various tweaks and nerfs, to enhance overall game performance and experience.

Key Collection Sequence:

 Corrected an issue where obtaining the key before interacting with the front door (doing things in the wrong order) would break the objectives list. This has been fixed.

Fuse Door Objective Bug:

 Resolved a situation where opening the fuse door while inside the house would cause the objective to incorrectly state "Find a way to unlock the shed."

Collision Fix:

 Fixed a collision problem with one of the tall cupboards by the bed.


This patch doesn't provide full bug fixes, if you find any bugs, DO NOT HESITATE TO E-MAIL US - support@galactic-crows, any pictures, videos will also be helpful.

We plan to add more content and even a new ending, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Exciting News: Stay Still 2 Patch Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We're overjoyed to share some exciting news with our devoted Stay Still 2 players! We're preparing to release a comprehensive patch that addresses several key improvements and bug fixes in our ongoing quest to improve your gaming experience.

🛠️ Improvements in the Pipeline:

Enhanced Collision Verification:
We're diving deep into the game to verify and refine each collision, ensuring a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience.

Strategic AI Tweaks:
Your encounters with the AI are about to get more challenging! To add an extra layer of excitement, we're adjusting the AI behavior to hit you twice for that intense gaming thrill.

Crystal-Clear Puzzle Hints:
Say goodbye to confusion! We're committed to providing crystal-clear hints for every puzzle, guiding you through the intricacies of the game so you never feel lost.

Pre-End Game Bug Squashing:
We're addressing those pesky bugs lurking in the pre-end game, ensuring that the puzzle code is not only solvable but also properly hinted for a seamless experience.

Save System Overhaul:
A proper fix for saving is on the way! Your progress deserves to be preserved, and we're working diligently to ensure a reliable and efficient save system.

Crash-Free Gameplay:
We're on a mission to eliminate crashes! Our team is thoroughly investigating any potential game crashes to enhance the overall stability and fluidity of your gaming sessions.

Patch ETA: One Week!

Mark your calendars! The patch is set to go live in about a week, bringing with it a slew of improvements that we believe will take your Stay Still 2 experience to new heights.

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates as we embark on this journey to make Stay Still 2 even better!

Have fun playing!

Galactic Crows.

notes.title: Stay Still 2 - Demo Patch v0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello there, brave gamers! We're excited to bring you a brand new patch update for Spooky Halloween Stay Still 2, which addresses a couple of issues to make the game even spookier and smoother. 🌕👻

🛠️ Here's what's been fixed and improved in this update:

Fixed the demo's ending animation: We listened to your feedback, and we're happy to report that we've fixed the problem where the demo's ending animation had a spooky glitch of its own - the door sometimes didn't open! There are no more impediments in your way; the door now opens as it should, allowing you to delve deeper into the eerie unknown. Prepare for a seamless and spine-tingling end to your demo experience!

A proper tutorial for the safe puzzle has been added: You won't have to scratch your head trying to figure out the combination. This addition ensures that you have all of the information you need to unlock the game's secrets. Expect a simpler and more rewarding puzzle-solving experience.

https://i.imgur.com/VEKE4iv.png

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for Stay Still 2. We're committed to giving you the best gaming experience possible, and your feedback is invaluable in helping us achieve that goal.

Please contact us if you encounter any additional issues or have additional suggestions. We're always listening, and we want to make your journey into the unknown as enthralling as possible.

The update is OUT NOW! 

Best wishes!
